heard: Three spacecraft will form a triangle wider than the Sun. This is LISA, a planned European Space Agency mission. Each side of the floating constellation stretches 1.6 million miles. The trio will trail Earth in a heliocentric orbit around the Sun. Gold platinum cubes will float freely inside every single craft. Lasers will measure space-time ripples smaller than an atom. That is how a triangle wider than the Sun listens to space-time.
